title: COBALT: Contextual Bandit Learning with Offline Trajectories for Multi-Turn Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2602.03806v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) for multi-turn code generation typically relies on online reinforcement learning (RL), in which models learn from repeatedly generated online rollouts. Although effective, online RL can be costly and unstable. In this paper, we present contextual bandit learning with offline trajectories (COBALT), a simple method that reuses offline multi-turn trajectories to efficiently train LLMs for multi-turn code generation. Building on the observation that multi-turn code generation is a one-step recoverable Markov decision process, COBALT first collects code generation trajectories using a reference LLM and divides them into partial trajectories. Then, during online bandit learning, the LLM is trained to complete each partial trajectory through single-step code generation. On LiveCodeBench, COBALT substantially improves R1-Distill 8B and Qwen3 8B by up to 9.0 and 6.2 absolute Pass@1 points and matche

translated_title: COBALT：基于离线轨迹的上下文老虎机学习用于多轮代码生成
translated_abstract: 训练大语言模型（LLM）进行多轮代码生成通常依赖在线强化学习（RL），即模型通过反复生成的在线 rollout 进行学习。虽然有效，但在线强化学习成本高昂且不稳定。本文提出了基于离线轨迹的上下文老虎机学习方法（COBALT），这是一种简单的方法，通过重用离线多轮轨迹来高效训练 LLM 进行多轮代码生成。基于多轮代码生成是一个单步可恢复马尔可夫决策过程的观察，COBALT 首先使用一个参考 LLM 收集代码生成轨迹，并将其划分为部分轨迹。然后，在在线老虎机学习过程中，训练 LLM 通过单步代码生成来补全每个部分轨迹。在 LiveCodeBench 上，COBALT 使 R1-Distill 8B 和 Qwen3 8B 的绝对 Pass@1 分数最多分别提升 9.0 和 6.2 个百分点，并匹敌了（原摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: COBALT 利用多轮代码生成是单步可恢复马尔可夫决策过程的观察，通过重用参考模型收集的离线多轮轨迹并采用单步补全的上下文老虎机学习，替代昂贵且不稳定的在线强化学习来高效训练 LLM 进行多轮代码生成。
en_tdlr: COBALT exploits the observation that multi-turn code generation is a one-step recoverable MDP, reusing offline multi-turn trajectories with single-step contextual bandit learning to efficiently train LLMs while avoiding costly and unstable online reinforcement learning.
